primary_hypothesis: Canonical fit is already saturated but paraphrase transfer is weak at birth: joint actual-write optimization has no enforced context-invariant subject-mediated edit. Non-subject prediction pathways and subject-key response variation across paraphrases are separable candidate mechanisms, not established causes.

native_comparison.local_source: /mnt/raid5/janghj/EasyEdit/easyeditor/models/alphaedit/compute_z.py:90-115 and memit/compute_z.py:137-152 inject the same delta at each context lookup position; delta is one vector per request.
native_comparison.qualification: Inspected local EasyEdit copies; this audit does not claim byte identity to historical server4 baseline native_root. The structural distinction is also explicit in native compute_z design.
native_comparison.ours: R is shared through fixed subject-key writer geometry but actual delta_l(t)=DeltaW_l k_l(t) is applied at every token; context-specific k implies context-specific delta even at the same subject.
native_comparison.norm: Current norm is sum over five independent layer/request blocks; it is a deliberate extension of native one-vector penalty, not a duplicate of the same scalar. Scaling it by 1/5 would be a method change, not an arithmetic bug fix.
native_comparison.native_KL: One KL row per request, not per layer. General KL uses a different prompt set and W0 teacher; it does not duplicate native current-entry KL.

minimal_forward_only_plan.requires: A frozen candidate and its actual entry/final weights present in RAM. Current scalar-only snapshot cannot recover these; no checkpoint is saved. Do not hotpatch running jobs. A separate controlled tiny reproduction would be needed.
minimal_forward_only_plan.selection: Fix eight request IDs before observing outcomes. Each has canonical plus one independently written and semantically checked paraphrase; exclude all official fixed10k evaluation prompts. The new paraphrase is diagnostic-only in this phase.
states: all positions except those target-prediction positions
minimal_forward_only_plan.implementation: Keep the same final all-five candidate. At every edited linear module compute F.linear(x,W_entry) and F.linear(x,W_final) on the same current x, and select token rows with torch.where(mask,...). This gives full-mask and empty-mask reference endpoints without adding rounded deltas; no optimization, layer selection, commit or history append.
minimal_forward_only_plan.positions: Use exact token IDs/masks/native subject lookup. Define target prediction positions from teacher-forced labels separately for desired/true target; remove subject overlap from target set and report empty sets. Never mask attention or change prefix/tokenization.
minimal_forward_only_plan.metrics: New/true full-target NLL and preference margin, first-token NLL, TF strict; same-prompt per-layer subject key, DeltaW_actual*k at subject and prediction positions, L8 subject displacement. Compare canonical vs new paraphrase norms/cosines as observations only.
minimal_forward_only_plan.budget: 8 requests x 2 prompt forms x 6 states x 2 target sequences = 192 prompt-target-state forwards, batchable; zero backwards; log physical chunks and token work. Local tensor capture adds no forward. Not executed.
minimal_forward_only_plan.interpretation: If non-subject-only recovers most canonical NLL improvement and subject-only does not, evidence supports non-subject pathway reliance. If subject-only is effective on canonical but not paraphrase and subject delta changes sharply, subject-key generalization is implicated. Report absolute NLL contrasts, not additive contribution fractions; paths interact.
minimal_forward_only_plan.next_method_test: Only after diagnosis, use a disjoint training augmentation set or same-prompt subject realization auxiliary objective, retain all-five eligibility, and reserve a separate disjoint paraphrase set plus official P for evaluation. Do not train on official P.
